wc_role.value: Leads defending champions Argentina at a record 6th World Cup; one of only THREE players ever (with Ronaldo and Mexico's Ochoa) to reach a sixth World Cup. STILL ALIVE in the bracket: scored the 83' goal as Argentina came back from 2-0 down to beat Egypt 3-2 in the R16 (2026-07-07, Romero 79', Messi 83', Enzo Fernandez 90+2'), advancing to face Switzerland in the QF. Now the outright all-time leading World Cup goalscorer in history (men's or women's) with 21 career goals, having passed Klose's men's record of 16 and Marta's overall record of 17 earlier in the tournament; 8 goals in WC2026 alone.

fitness.value: Muscle fatigue / left-hamstring strain in the build-up; confirmed to feature but with managed minutes
